## 116:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For he-has-inclined his-ear to-me, and-in-my-days I-will-call.
- **LOGOS:** Because he inclined his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
- **PNEUMA:** Because he has turned his ear toward me, I will call on him for as long as I live.
